title: The 4.2 step tick-monotonicity latch has zero test coverage
detail: The guard latches replay_error and returns before any state advance; no test anywhere steps a run backward (replay_error=true exists only in step.odin), so the new critical-path error branch has zero execution coverage.
recommended_fix: Add a test stepping tick N then N-1, asserting replay_error latched, state.tick unchanged, and no events appended; mirror the command-failure latch coverage if one is added.

title: Settled queue-at-bound trigger scan (crisis_find_saturated_bundle ok=true) never fires in any test
detail: Every fixture's saturated tick also sheds same-tick (arrivals at a bound lane drop), so the drop scan always wins and crisis_find_saturated_bundle's ok=true branch never executes — the settled queue-at-bound half of the pinned trigger contract has no positive pin.
recommended_fix: Add a fixture where the lane sits at the E9 bound with surge-class backlog but no drop that tick (another class holds the lane), asserting Crisis_Triggered fires via the settled scan.

title: No byte-layout unit pin for the 4.2 serialization surface (drop target, tags 8/9 payload, crises section)
detail: warnings_test pins tags 1-7 bytes against a hand-built writer (test_event_payload_byte_layout); the 4.2 surface — drop payload target, tags 8/9 payloads, the crises section — has no such pin. Deterministic-but-wrong layouts pass replay and blessed T1 goldens.
recommended_fix: Extend test_event_payload_byte_layout with a 4.2 sibling: hand-built expected bytes for tags 8/9, the drop target field, and the active-crises section, including absent-when-empty.

title: E22 drop events' target=NO_BUNDLE assignment has no unit assertion
detail: Drop-event tests count only (class, reason) via count_drops; the pool-crisis filter skips target matching when bundle==NO_BUNDLE, so a wrong E22 target value is never caught at unit level — only frozen into blessed T1 bytes.
recommended_fix: Assert in the pool-crisis test (or qos_test) that Pool_Exhaustion drop events carry target == NO_BUNDLE and Queue_Overflow drops carry their shed bundle.

title: Resolve-margin clamp branch (bound <= margin) never executes in any test
evidence:
margin := CRISIS_RESOLVE_MARGIN
			if bound > 0 && bound <= margin { margin = bound - 1 }
detail: The clamp guards tiny lane_queue_packets catalogs (1-2) against a never-reachable resolve; balance.json pins bound 6, so the branch never executes in any test — an untested boundary in the resolve hysteresis.
recommended_fix: Add a catalog variant with lane_queue_packets <= 2 asserting a saturated crisis still resolves (no forever-active crisis).

title: Earliest-drop attribution across multiple bundles in one tick is untested
detail: The overwrite scan names the earliest shed bundle as root cause; every fixture sheds on a single bundle, so multi-bundle same-tick shedding — the determinism-critical attribution order — never executes in any test.
recommended_fix: Add a two-bundle fixture shedding the surge class on both in one tick; assert the crisis names the earlier drop's bundle.
